summary: Iteration 137 Testing Complete - WebRTC Transceiver Fix + PreJoinPage Bug Fix. Backend: 9/9 tests passed. Frontend: PreJoinPage runtime error fixed (chooseLiveRoute hoisting issue), Chat in video call works, Admin LiveKit config panel works. WebRTC transceiver fix (iter 137) verified via code review - unconditional addTransceiver('audio/video', 'sendrecv') ensures SDP offers always have m-lines.

issues: 'Made with Emergent' badge overlaps with chat send button - requires force=True to click (same as iter 135)

bugs_fixed_during_testing.root_cause: useEffect on line 264 had chooseLiveRoute in dependency array, but chooseLiveRoute was defined AFTER the useEffect (line 273). JavaScript useCallback functions are not hoisted.
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Inlined the route decision logic inside the useEffect instead of calling chooseLiveRoute function

webrtc_transceiver_fix_code_review.details: LiveMeetingPage.js createPeer (lines 302-344) now unconditionally adds audio+video transceivers with direction='sendrecv' (lines 311-312). This ensures SDP offers always have m=audio and m=video lines even for listener-only users. Tracks are attached via replaceTrack (lines 318-319). All toggle/switch functions (toggleMic, toggleCamera, switchCamera, switchMicrophone, handleShareScreen) now use s?.audioTransceiver?.sender?.replaceTrack() and s?.videoTransceiver?.sender?.replaceTrack() instead of pc.getSenders().find().

websocket_signaling_test.details: Backend WebSocket signaling verified: admin connects first, receives empty peers list. User2 connects, receives peers list with admin. Admin receives peer-joined for user2. All via authenticated ws-token.

chat_in_video_call.details: Chat panel opens via toggle-chat-button, messages sent via Enter key appear in chat panel with sender name and timestamp. Backend POST /api/meetings/{id}/chat stores messages, GET returns history.

admin_livekit_config_panel.details: Admin > Integrationen tab shows LiveKit SFU Konfiguration with 'Aktiv' badge, LiveKit URL (wss://meetflow-klinik-9bwc0e2v.livekit.cloud), API Key (APIz5TqJuzPoBBG), masked API Secret, and threshold configuration.

prejoin_page_fix.details: PreJoinPage now loads without runtime error. Fixed chooseLiveRoute hoisting issue by inlining route decision logic.

backend_pytest.details: 9/9 tests passed: LiveKit config status, meeting creation, WebSocket peers broadcast, chat in meeting (2 tests), WebSocket stress test, admin integrations, third user creation, cleanup

action_items: CRITICAL: Real 3-participant WebRTC test requires manual testing with 3 actual browser windows with camera permissions. Playwright cannot fully simulate this as it runs headless without real camera devices.
20-participant stress test: Backend WebSocket handling verified, but full 20-user mesh test requires 20 authenticated users which is impractical in automated testing.
Minor: 'Made with Emergent' badge still overlaps chat send button
